page_title: Free AI Photo Editor & Image Generator | 30+ AI Tools

sources.entry: AIPhotoeditor - AIPhotoeditor is a free photo editor that allows users to remove unwanted objects, people, blemishes, or text from their images in seconds. #free

summary.name: photoeditor.ai
summary.one_liner: A browser-based collection of 30+ single-purpose AI photo tools for cleanup, background removal, upscaling, restoration, and image generation.
use_cases: Remove photobombers or unwanted objects from a photo
Restore a blurry or damaged old family photo
Upscale a low-resolution image for printing
Remove background to make a transparent PNG
Generate product shots or illustrations from a text prompt
Create a logo and export it as SVG
summary.what_it_does: The site offers 30+ AI image tools grouped into categories such as AI Edit, AI Generators, AI Enhance, AI Remover, AI Background, watermark removal, and SVG conversion. Edits can be driven by a text prompt, a brush over an area, or a reference image. Tools cover removing objects, people, text, and watermarks; background removal with transparent PNG export; sharpening, denoising, and restoring old photos; and upscaling to 4K and 8K plus outpainting to extend the frame. The page says each tool defaults to a chosen AI model (such as Nano Banana, GPT Image, Gemini, or SeeDream) and that the model can be switched in the settings rail. Uploads accept JPG, PNG, HEIC, AVIF, and WEBP up to 15MB.
notable: Each tool is a dedicated single-purpose page rather than one general editor
Per-task default AI model selection, switchable by the user
Browser-based with no app install or signup for free tools
Commercial use of AI outputs is stated as allowed
caveats: Free downloads are limited to 720px; HD and 4K exports require a PRO subscription
Full 30+ tool suite is unlocked on PRO
Users are responsible for the rights to source images
